synth.notes:
Mirror-axis game on a 21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks: one horizontal axis (wall), 2 pieces, targets, and reflections mirrored across the axis row (r -> 2a-r, skipped on the axis and on piece blocks).
ACTION5 cycles axis -> pieces in (x,y) order; ACTION1-4 move the selection one block. The axis moves only vertically, and A3/A4 do nothing to it.
Mechanic the committee missed (step 71): pieces do NOT block the axis. It moves onto and under piece rows freely. Pieces are blocked only by the board edges and by other pieces.
Render by layer (wall1 < target2 < reflection3 < piece4); the selected wall centre is solid 0, other centres are holes. Re-extract walls/pieces as 4-connected components of own cells plus all 0 cells, ranked by (x,y). The 'born/no_change' outcome is re-extraction, not an object field.
Passes 30/30 with and without hidden state. Unconfirmed: piece->piece->axis cycle order, and whether a piece may move onto the axis row.
